name: Resource Signal Readers
author: shander
description: Three Logic-tab blocks - Gold Reader, Energy Reader, Fluxite Reader - that emit a true signal to connected logic wires whenever the matching stored resource is at or above a threshold. Click a placed block to open a small panel and set its own threshold; each block remembers its own value. Use one block per resource; place several to watch more than one at a time.

goldThreshold.label: Gold Reader Default Threshold
goldThreshold.description: Starting threshold for newly placed Gold Reader blocks (click a placed block to override it individually).

energyThreshold.label: Energy Reader Default Threshold
energyThreshold.description: Starting threshold for newly placed Energy Reader blocks (click a placed block to override it individually).

fluxiteThreshold.label: Fluxite Reader Default Threshold
fluxiteThreshold.description: Starting threshold for newly placed Fluxite Reader blocks (click a placed block to override it individually).
